courses.title: Fine-Tuning and Model Adaptation for AI Teams
courses.description: Fine-Tuning and Model Adaptation for AI Teams focuses on fine-tuning and model adaptation for people working toward a LLM Engineer role, through hands-on exercises and short review checkpoints. It also introduces people and project management, enough to apply alongside fine-tuning and model adaptation in real LLM Engineer work. By the end, you'll be able to explain your approach to fine-tuning and model adaptation and show how people and project management supports it.
learning_outcomes: Applying fine-tuning and model adaptation to a real LLM Engineer scenario
Practicing fine-tuning and model adaptation through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to people and project management
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: Model Deployment Pipelines for Practitioners
courses.description: Model Deployment Pipelines for Practitioners goes beyond the basics of model deployment pipelines, for people already working toward a LLM Engineer role. Through a handful of applied exercises and more realistic scenarios, you'll build the kind of judgement that only comes with practice, rather than following a fixed recipe. It's built for people who already have some grounding in model deployment pipelines and want to go further.

alternates.title: Fine-Tuning and Model Adaptation Essentials
alternates.description: Fine-Tuning and Model Adaptation Essentials is a short introduction to fine-tuning and model adaptation for people moving toward a LLM Engineer role. You'll walk through the essential vocabulary and a few guided exercises that show fine-tuning and model adaptation in context, with no prior experience assumed. The pace is gentle, with short lessons rather than a heavy project. It's a reasonable starting point if fine-tuning and model adaptation is new to you.
learning_outcomes: Applying fine-tuning and model adaptation to a real LLM Engineer scenario
Practicing fine-tuning and model adaptation through guided exercises
Building a short fine-tuning and model adaptation exercise from scratch
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

alternates.title: Advanced Fine-Tuning and Model Adaptation Techniques
alternates.description: Advanced Fine-Tuning and Model Adaptation Techniques is a focused course on fine-tuning and model adaptation for people already working toward a LLM Engineer role who want to go further. You'll work through applied exercises that push past the basics and into more realistic scenarios, with less hand-holding than an introductory course. By the end, you should feel noticeably more confident applying fine-tuning and model adaptation on your own.
